findings.body:
**Lease an open-PR replay against the journaled target.**

Recovery checks the journaled target against `pr_info()`, but leases the push against the separate `ls-remote` result. If that result observes a reset to ancestor `A` while `pr_info()` reports the journaled target `T`, the ancestry check passes. If the ref is still at `A` at push time, Git accepts the lease and restores the commits the maintainer removed. For open PRs, use `publication['target']` as the expected ref value, as the initial push does. Keep the path that finalizes an already-landed repair without pushing. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push?utm_source=openai))
findings.title: Lease an open-PR replay against the journaled target.

findings.body:
**Recheck provider admission after scanning the payload.**

Worker A can read provider P as ready at Line 321 and begin scanning. If worker B persists a cooldown for P before A finishes, A checks only blackout before invoking P. Recheck the selected provider's cooldown at the final launch boundary. If it is active, let the fallback loop try another eligible provider without treating the local deferral as a new provider rate-limit response.
findings.title: Recheck provider admission after scanning the payload.

findings.body:
**Do not accept an opaque head diff as containment proof.**

If a follow-up commit replaces a repaired text file with a binary blob and leaves its mode unchanged, Git reports a binary difference without text hunks. `diff_changed_locations()` returns empty sets, so `change_undone()` finds nothing and `merge_head_evidence()` records `contained`. Reject a binary head diff when the published repair depended on text changes. Keep the identical-blob fast path and the text-hunk comparison. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitattributes.html?utm_source=openai))
findings.title: Do not accept an opaque head diff as containment proof.

findings.body:
**Report why an automatic drain did not start.**

If the clone fetch fails or cannot acquire the tick lock, `drain()` returns `None`. `run()` converts that to `{"status":"drained"}` with exit 0, the same result as a completed pass. A caller that reads only JSON cannot tell that no inbox work ran. Return a structured `deferred`, `paused`, or `refused` result from each early exit and reserve `drained` for a pass that ran.
findings.title: Report why an automatic drain did not start.

findings.body:
**Continue admitting independent items after an ordinary worker failure.**

If `mark_stale()` cannot write a result, the exception escapes `drain_item()` before its handler. The child exits 1. `reap_completed()` then sets the same stop flag used for provider pauses and handover, so the coordinator skips healthy items that have not started. The serial path also aborts on that exception. Record the item failure separately from admission stops in both paths, and continue with the remaining items. As per coding guidelines, “Fleet runs collect all results and never bail mid-fleet.”
findings.title: Continue admitting independent items after an ordinary worker failure.

findings.body:
**Charge payload preparation to the shared dispatch deadline.**

If a rung has 60 seconds left and the snapshot and diff scans take 40 seconds, `_dispatch()` still gives the CQ driver the earlier 60-second allowance. A scan that consumes the whole allowance can still be followed by a paid invocation. Pass the absolute deadline through preparation. At launch, use the actual remaining time or return `budget` without starting the driver. Use that same remaining time for the blackout check.






Also applies to: 444-445
findings.title: Charge payload preparation to the shared dispatch deadline.

findings.body:
**Keep completed repairs retryable when the delivery row cannot be read.**

`require_canonical_delivery()` raises `ValueError` for both a read failure and a confirmed ownership mismatch. At Line 478, `harvest()` handles both by marking the run `stale`. If the row becomes readable on the next tick and still names this job, the terminal-state branch at Line 425 skips its verified result. Distinguish unavailable evidence from confirmed loss of ownership. Retry the former without publishing, and keep the stale disposition for the latter.
findings.title: Keep completed repairs retryable when the delivery row cannot be read.
